conditions: Dealing in, advising on, or managing portfolios investing in Tokenised Securities

claims.action: Remain responsible for overall operation despite outsourcing
claims.actor: Intermediaries issuing or substantially involved in issuing Tokenised Securities
conditions: The intermediary issues or is substantially involved in issuing the securities.
It intends to deal in or advise on those securities.

evidence.quote: 13. Where intermediaries issue (eg, fund managers of tokenised funds) or are substantially involved in the issuance of the Tokenised Securities which they intend to deal in or advise on, they remain responsible for the overall operation of the tokenisation arrangement notwithstanding any outsourcing to third-party vendors/service providers.
